# Fire TV Captive Portal
> Fire TV Captive Portal provides guidance and tooling for connecting Amazon Fire TV devices to captive portal Wi‑Fi networks.

This site focuses on helping Fire TV users work around hotel, dorm, and public Wi‑Fi login pages that do not appear automatically on the device. It includes setup instructions, troubleshooting guidance, compatibility notes, and related support resources.

## Getting Started
- [Home](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/): Overview of the captive portal issue on Fire TV devices and available guidance.
- [How It Works](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/how-it-works/): Explains the captive portal detection problem and the site’s general workaround approach.
- [Setup Guide](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/setup-guide/): Step-by-step instructions for connecting a Fire TV device through captive portal Wi‑Fi.
- [Quick Start](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/quick-start/): Short setup path for users who want the fastest connection workflow.

## Device Guides
- [Fire TV Stick Guide](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/fire-tv-stick/): Instructions tailored for Fire TV Stick models using captive portal networks.
- [Fire TV Cube Guide](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/fire-tv-cube/): Device-specific notes and setup steps for Fire TV Cube users.
- [Fire TV Smart TV Guide](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/fire-tv-smart-tv/): Guidance for televisions with Fire TV built in.
- [Older Fire TV Devices](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/older-devices/): Compatibility and setup notes for legacy Fire TV hardware.

## Network Scenarios
- [Hotel Wi‑Fi](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/hotel-wifi/): Instructions for connecting Fire TV devices on hotel captive portal networks.
- [Dorm and Campus Wi‑Fi](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/dorm-wifi/): Setup guidance for student housing and campus-managed login networks.
- [Airport and Public Wi‑Fi](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/public-wifi/): Tips for public hotspots that require browser-based authentication.
- [Travel Router Option](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/travel-router/): Describes using a travel router to simplify captive portal authentication.

## Troubleshooting
- [Troubleshooting Overview](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/troubleshooting/): Common connection failures and the main steps to resolve them.
- [Portal Page Not Showing](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/portal-page-not-showing/): Fixes for cases where the login page never appears.
- [Connected but No Internet](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/connected-no-internet/): Troubleshooting for partial connections after Wi‑Fi association succeeds.
- [DNS and Redirect Issues](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/dns-redirect-issues/): Notes on DNS behavior and redirect problems on captive networks.
- [Restart and Reset Steps](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/restart-reset/): Basic recovery actions for stuck network sessions and device state.

## Compatibility
- [Supported Fire TV Models](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/supported-models/): Lists device families and expected captive portal behavior.
- [Supported Network Types](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/supported-networks/): Describes which captive portal implementations are most likely to work.
- [Known Limitations](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/known-limitations/): Documents scenarios where captive portal login may remain unreliable.
- [Firmware Considerations](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/firmware/): Notes on Fire OS versions and software updates affecting connectivity.

## Guides and Tips
- [Manual Browser Launch](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/manual-browser-launch/): Methods for opening a browser or trigger page to force portal detection.
- [Using a Phone Hotspot Temporarily](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/phone-hotspot/): Temporary hotspot workflow for setup and account sign-in tasks.
- [MAC Address Registration](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/mac-registration/): Guidance for networks that require device registration by MAC address.
- [Improving Connection Reliability](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/connection-reliability/): Practical tips for reducing repeated captive portal login issues.

## FAQ
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about Fire TV captive portal connectivity.
- [Why Fire TV Won’t Open the Login Page](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/why-no-login-page/): Explains why captive portal detection can fail on streaming devices.
- [Can You Use Fire TV in Hotels](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/fire-tv-in-hotels/): Covers expected behavior and setup considerations for travel use.
- [Do You Need Extra Hardware](https://firetvcaptiveportal.com/extra-hardware/): Discusses when adapters or travel routers may be helpful.
